examples.zh: 如果工厂关门，600名工人将失去工作。

examples.en: She published her article in the newspaper.
examples.zh: 她在报纸上发表了她的文章。

examples.en: The government publishes job numbers every six months.
examples.zh: 政府每六个月公布一次工作数据。

examples.en: The winner's name will be published in June.
examples.zh: 获胜者的名字将在六月公布。

examples.en: Twelve people died in the accident.
examples.zh: 十二个人在事故中死了。

examples.en: She died of hunger.
examples.zh: 她死于饥饿。

examples.en: He died of a heart attack.
examples.zh: 他死于心脏病。

examples.en: This is a hotel guide.
examples.zh: 这是一本酒店指南。

examples.en: He bought a bird guide for his trip.
examples.zh: 他为旅行买了一本鸟类指南。

examples.en: Buy a good guide to Spain before you go.
examples.zh: 去西班牙前买一本好的指南。

examples.en: First, tell the patient her problem is real, not in her head.
examples.zh: 首先，告诉病人她的问题是真实的，不是她想象出来的。

examples.en: There is a real danger that he will lose his job.
examples.zh: 他丢掉工作的危险是真实存在的。

examples.en: He thinks climate change is not real.
examples.zh: 他认为气候变化不是真的。

examples.en: I imagined a big blue whale in the sea.
examples.zh: 我想象海里有一条巨大的蓝鲸。

examples.en: She imagined her dream house with a garden.
examples.zh: 她想象着带有花园的梦想之家。

examples.en: We imagined the future and smiled together.
examples.zh: 我们想象着未来，一起笑了。

examples.en: The movie's plot is very simple.
examples.zh: 这部电影的故事情节很简单。

examples.en: The plots of his books are all the same.
examples.zh: 他书的故事情节都是一样的。

examples.en: The movie's plot is about a wrong person.
examples.zh: 这部电影的故事情节是关于一个认错人的事。

examples.en: Do you believe in fairies?
examples.zh: 你相信有小精灵吗？

examples.en: She thought fairies lived in her garden.
examples.zh: 她以前觉得花园里住着小精灵。

examples.en: She often daydreams like a fairy.
examples.zh: 她经常像小精灵一样做白日梦。

examples.en: He is a nurse in a hospital.
examples.zh: 他是一家医院的护士。

examples.en: Nurse Millard will come soon.
examples.zh: 米勒德护士很快就来。

examples.en: Thank you, Nurse, for your help.
examples.zh: 谢谢你，护士，谢谢你的帮助。

examples.en: He was happily married and had two kids.
examples.zh: 他婚姻幸福，有两个孩子。

examples.en: She ate her chocolate bar happily.
examples.zh: 她高兴地吃着自己的巧克力棒。

examples.en: I would happily help him if I could.
examples.zh: 如果我能的话，我会高兴地帮助他。

examples.en: We finally got home at 12:00 at night.
examples.zh: 我们终于在晚上十二点到了家。

examples.en: He looked for months and finally found a job.
examples.zh: 他找了几个月，终于找到了一份工作。

examples.en: We finally said yes to the deal.
examples.zh: 我们终于同意了这笔交易。

examples.en: The video shows him walking in the snow with a walking stick.
examples.zh: 视频显示他拿着手杖在雪中行走。

examples.en: She leans on a walking stick after her knee surgery.
examples.zh: 她膝盖手术后拄着手杖。

examples.en: He can still walk around with a walking stick.
examples.zh: 他仍然可以拄着手杖到处走。

examples.en: Do you want peaches and cream for dessert?
examples.zh: 你甜点想要桃子和奶油吗？

examples.en: The peach skin feels soft and fuzzy.
examples.zh: 桃子皮摸起来又软又毛茸茸的。

examples.en: This peach is very sweet and juicy.
examples.zh: 这个桃子又甜又多汁。

examples.en: I filled the bucket with water.
examples.zh: 我把水桶装满了水。

examples.en: I can hear the tank filling.
examples.zh: 我能听到水箱正在装满水。

examples.en: She filled her time watching TV.
examples.zh: 她看电视打发时间。

examples.en: Don't give up, you can do it.
examples.zh: 不要放弃，你能做到的。

examples.en: He gave up the game at last.
examples.zh: 他最后放弃了比赛。

examples.en: She never gives up her dream.
examples.zh: 她从不放弃她的梦想。

examples.en: She smiled in the face of trouble.
examples.zh: 她面对困难时笑了。

examples.en: We must be brave in the face of danger.
examples.zh: 面对危险，我们必须勇敢。

examples.en: He kept trying in the face of failure.
examples.zh: 面对失败，他继续尝试。

examples.en: We ask people to do some simple tasks on the computer.
examples.zh: 我们请人们在电脑上做一些简单的任务。

examples.en: The government has a big and hard task to change the health service.
examples.zh: 政府有一项重大而艰巨的任务，那就是改革医疗服务。

examples.en: She told her assistant it was a bad task because she was careless.
examples.zh: 她批评她的助手，因为她粗心大意。

examples.en: Black put the ball into the goal.
examples.zh: 布莱克把球踢进了球门。

examples.en: She got the ball and ran to the goal.
examples.zh: 她拿到球，跑向球门。

examples.en: Brazil won the game, three goals to one.
examples.zh: 巴西队赢了比赛，三比一。

examples.en: He left a note to say he would be late home.
examples.zh: 他留了张便条，说要晚点回家。

examples.en: The note on the door says when the shop opens again.
examples.zh: 门上的便条写着商店什么时候再开门。

examples.en: Please read Note 3 for more information.
examples.zh: 请读注释3了解更多信息。

examples.en: Do you remember the accident? No, it happened so suddenly.
examples.zh: 你记得那场事故吗？不，它发生得太突然了。

examples.en: I was sleeping when suddenly I heard a scream outside.
examples.zh: 我正在睡觉，突然听到外面有尖叫声。

examples.en: I suddenly knew what I said, but it was too late.
examples.zh: 我突然明白了我说了什么，但已经太晚了。

examples.en: They must decide before next Friday.
examples.zh: 他们必须在下周五前做决定。

examples.en: It's OK for me. You decide.
examples.zh: 我都可以。你决定吧。

examples.en: At last, we decided to go to the theatre.
examples.zh: 最后，我们决定去剧院。

examples.en: The police entered the building by the side door.
examples.zh: 警察从侧门进入了大楼。

examples.en: The drug enters your blood and makes you sleepy.
examples.zh: 药物进入你的血液，让你想睡觉。

examples.en: Her eyes smiled when she saw him enter the room.
examples.zh: 她看到他走进房间时，眼睛亮了起来。

examples.en: She stood up and walked towards him.
examples.zh: 她站起来，朝他走去。

examples.en: He leaned towards his wife and said, "Go home soon?"
examples.zh: 他靠向妻子，说：“很快回家吗？”

examples.en: She looked towards the phone many times.
examples.zh: 她多次看向电话。

examples.en: She walked toward him.
examples.zh: 她朝他走过去。

examples.en: He leaned toward her and said, "Go home?"
examples.zh: 他靠向她，说：“回家？”

examples.en: She looked toward the phone.
examples.zh: 她朝电话看去。

examples.en: The box is too heavy to carry.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，搬不动。

examples.en: She is too tired to run.
examples.zh: 她太累了，跑不动了。

examples.en: The water is too hot to drink.
examples.zh: 水太烫了，不能喝。

examples.en: We will reach Miami at five or six.
examples.zh: 我们将在五六点钟到达迈阿密。

examples.en: They reached the coast after five weeks.
examples.zh: 五周后他们到达了海岸。

examples.en: We just reached the news of his accident.
examples.zh: 我们刚刚得知他出事的消息。

examples.en: She moved to London to find work as a model, but failed.
examples.zh: 她搬到伦敦去找模特工作，但失败了。

examples.en: This way of growing tomatoes never fails.
examples.zh: 这种种西红柿的方法从不失败。

examples.en: He failed in his try to break the record.
examples.zh: 他尝试打破纪录，但失败了。

examples.en: I did my homework on my own.
examples.zh: 我独自完成了作业。

examples.en: She can dress herself on her own.
examples.zh: 她能自己穿衣服。

examples.en: He cooked dinner on his own last night.
examples.zh: 他昨晚独自做了晚饭。
